subject: A four-minute daily routine improved chair-stand and balance scores
script: From Agewell Brief: A four-minute daily routine improved chair-stand and balance scores. New research suggests a brief daily resistance exercise routine can improve strength and balance in older adults. Here’s what the study found—and what it doesn’t prove. For many older adults, the idea of a lengthy workout can feel overwhelming. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
